name: Pulmonary Alveolar Proteinosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Pulmonary Alveolar Proteinosis

criteria.description: Characteristic milky appearance of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid with periodic acid–Schiff (PAS) positive lipoproteinaceous material
High-resolution CT showing bilateral, symmetric ground-glass opacities with interlobular septal thickening ('crazy paving' pattern)
Lung biopsy demonstrating alveolar filling with granular eosinophilic material positive for PAS stain
Presence of anti-GM-CSF autoantibodies in serum (for autoimmune PAP)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic bronchoalveolar lavage findings and compatible high-resolution CT imaging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lung biopsy is reserved for uncertain cases; anti-GM-CSF antibody testing supports autoimmune etiology

laboratory: Mild hypoxemia on arterial blood gas
imaging: High-resolution CT showing bilateral ground-glass opacities with interlobular septal thickening ('crazy paving')
Chest X-ray with bilateral alveolar infiltrates
genetic: Mutations in CSF2RA or CSF2RB genes in hereditary PAP
other: Bronchoalveolar lavage fluid with milky appearance and PAS-positive material
Lung biopsy showing alveolar filling with lipoproteinaceous material

distinguishingFeatures: Fibrotic changes on imaging rather than alveolar filling
Progressive restrictive lung disease with honeycombing
Absence of milky bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
Imaging shows interstitial and alveolar edema without PAS-positive material
Presence of infectious organisms on cultures
Fever and systemic signs of infection

references: Trapnell BC, Nakata K, Bonella F, et al. Pulmonary alveolar proteinosis. Nat Rev Dis Primers. 2019;5(1):16.
Borie R, Danel C, Debray MP, et al. Pulmonary alveolar proteinosis. Eur Respir Rev. 2011;20(120):98-107.
Inoue Y, Trapnell BC, Tazawa R, et al. Characteristics of a large cohort of patients with autoimmune pulmonary alveolar proteinosis in Japan. Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2008;177(7):752-762.
